mapper.select: SELECT P.PLACE_NO AS placeNo, P.PLACE_NAME AS placeName, P.PLACE_DESCRIPTION AS placeDescription, P.ADDR AS addr, P.ADDR_DETAIL AS addrDetail, P.X_AXIS AS xAxis, P.Y_AXIS AS yAxis, T.TYPE_NO AS typeNo, T.TYPE AS type, TD.TYPE_DETAIL_NO AS typeDetailNo, TD.TYPE_DETAIL_CONTENT AS typeDetail, P.VIEW_COUNT AS viewCount, ( SELECT MAX(PI.IMG_PATH || PI.SAVE_NAME) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY PI.IMG_ORDER, PI.IMG_NO) FROM PLACE_IMG PI WHERE PI.PLACE_NO = P.PLACE_NO AND PI.DEL_YN = 'N' ) AS imageUrl, TG.TAG_NO AS tagNo, TG.TAG_CONTENT AS tagContent FROM PLACE P JOIN TYPE_DETAIL TD ON TD.TYPE_DETAIL_NO = P.TYPE_DETAIL_NO JOIN TYPE T ON T.TYPE_NO = TD.TYPE_NO LEFT JOIN PLACE_TAG PT ON PT.PLACE_NO = P.PLACE_NO LEFT JOIN TAG TG ON TG.TAG_NO = PT.TAG_NO WHERE P.DEL_YN = 'N' AND P.X_AXIS IS NOT NULL AND P.Y_AXIS IS NOT NULL ORDER BY P.PLACE_NO, TG.TAG_NO
